query:
INSERT INTO core.objects (kind, name, address, area_m2, floor_part, premises_type_code)
         SELECT o.kind, $2, o.address, o.area_m2, o.floor_part, o.premises_type_code
         FROM core.objects o
         JOIN core.lots l ON l.object_id = o.id
         WHERE l.tender_id = $1
         RETURNING id
